name: 40220 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40220 (Louisville) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40220 (Louisville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 40220 (Louisville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
